subject: Appointment follow-up and room suggestion
text:
Dear seminar group,

Thank you for checking on the appointment we discussed for reviewing research timelines. Tuesday at 4 p.m. still works well for me, but I appreciate flexibility if another slot suits everyone better. A helpful suggestion might be to move the meeting to the quieter study room on the second floor, since the library area is often noisy in late afternoon. That would make it easier to discuss each chapter without interruption. If timing needs to shift, Wednesday morning could also work, provided we share notes in advance so the meeting remains short and focused.
